title: The KPop Demon Hunters Christmas Gift Guide for Girls
description: A KPop Demon Hunters Christmas gift guide for girls from Sam's Club: the HUNTR/X Bluetooth karaoke machine, the LEGO Derpy Tiger and Sussie Bird, Zak Designs KPop tumblers, a KPop Demon Hunters throw, the Golden singing doll and My Golden Journal.
intro: If there's a kid in your life, you already know every word to Golden. You didn't choose this. It chose you. So lean in. This list is the whole HUNTR/X Christmas: a purple karaoke machine for the living room concerts that are happening whether you like it or not, the LEGO Derpy Tiger and Sussie Bird, KPop tumblers, a soft throw for movie re-watch number forty, the Golden singing doll and a journal for all her very serious song lyrics. Earplugs not included.

sections.heading: The big gifts
paragraphs: The KPop Demon Hunters Bluetooth Karaoke Machine with Microphones, the LEGO KPop Demon Hunters Derpy Tiger and Sussie Bird set with 825 pieces, and the KPop Demon Hunters HUNTR/X "Golden" Singing Doll with Accessories.

sections.heading: The cozy extras
paragraphs: The Zak Designs KPop 20 oz stainless steel Sutton Flex Grip Siply tumblers, the KPop Demon Hunters Silk Touch Throw at 50 by 60 inches, and KPop Demon Hunters: My Golden Journal in hardcover.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The gaming room, the tree and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
